notes: Draft configuration: The organizer's 2025 regulations explicitly start the Great Western Sprint at the pit lane exit and finish at Westway on the second lap, over one and three-quarter laps. The independent route retains the 188.9 m initial mapped pit-exit section and complete circuit before returning to the mapped finish. Every join and repeated lap section uses exact pinned source nodes. The 5360.4 m timed route differs from the catalogue scalar of 3006 m; the organizer describes 3.3 miles. Fine timing extent and historical lap count remain draft, without scaling or replacing the sprint with a closed venue loop. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 5360.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

approach.note: Pit-exit approach limits are approximate sparse measurements on the pinned licensed MapTiler mosaic (0.7437 m ground pixels; capture date unknown). Paved boundaries were inspected in native and rectified cross-sections. The last cross-section inherits the original circuit border intersections, not a new imagery measurement. Intermediate sections are interpolated and are not a road survey.

sources.notes: The complete saved source sequence is driven from a standing start, including its approach and repeated circuit sections. One physical circuit and its elevation profile are reused on every pass; no return road is added. The approach uses sparse image-measured left/right estimates under LicenseRef-MapTiler-Derived-Borders (© MapTiler © OpenStreetMap contributors); the last section inherits the original circuit borders. Those original borders retain their separate feature-level licences. Terrain follows the existing approximately 77 m grid, compressed within 0.5 m of its samples, not a road survey. Timing metadata are preserved; source endpoints define the simulated start and finish. Finish speed is unconstrained. Curbs are curvature-based illustrations with assumed dimensions and colours, not imagery-verified curbs. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Imagery loads externally; only measurements and parameters are saved.
